opportunities.name: Dragon third bite
opportunities.objective: Use the inspected reworked dragon Q's extra recast as a mixed-damage finish.
opportunities.mechanic: Q attacks reduce its cooldown and carry a health-based magic on-hit. The active can recast, and dragon form adds a third bite with a 1.5 multiplier and true damage. Nashor, Dusk and Terminus test real attack delivery while R's finite Fury constrains form duration.
opportunities.requiredState: Dragon form with recorded Fury and passive stacks; all three Q attacks connect.
opportunities.failure: Form expires before the bite or kiting prevents cooldown-reducing attacks.
opportunities.test: Separate first, second and dragon-only third Q packets, then test Dusk repeat without assuming active duplication.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Legacy twin-bite or burnout interactions do not describe this Emberstrike/Inferno Aegis kit.

opportunities.name: Aegis crowd recovery
opportunities.objective: Convert nearby champions into a larger shield and a timed dragon detonation heal.
opportunities.mechanic: W shield includes a bonus-health Stat term and increases per nearby champion; dragon W heals on champion detonation using missing health. Visage supports both shield and heal, Riftmaker converts health to AP and Abyssal boosts nearby magic damage from W/E. R adds finite bonus health.
opportunities.requiredState: Dragon form, nearby champion count and missing health recorded before W recast.
opportunities.failure: Enemies leave before detonation or burst breaks the shield while the heal cannot connect.
opportunities.test: Measure shield and heal with one versus three nearby champions at matched missing health, then compare human form.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Human W does not inherit the dragon-only detonation heal.

ruledOut.reason: Scalemail requires actual takedowns; choose finite stacks instead of granting unbounded Armor/MR.

unknowns: Reworked Q active on-hit delivery, dragon Fury area reduction and W health Stat flag need live confirmation.

builds.name: Dragon third bite
builds.summary: Use the inspected reworked dragon Q's extra recast as a mixed-damage finish.
builds.goal: Use the inspected reworked dragon Q's extra recast as a mixed-damage finish.
builds.hypothesis: Q attacks reduce its cooldown and carry a health-based magic on-hit. The active can recast, and dragon form adds a third bite with a 1.5 multiplier and true damage. Nashor, Dusk and Terminus test real attack delivery while R's finite Fury constrains form duration.
testPlan: Required state: Dragon form with recorded Fury and passive stacks; all three Q attacks connect.
Separate first, second and dragon-only third Q packets, then test Dusk repeat without assuming active duplication.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Form expires before the bite or kiting prevents cooldown-reducing attacks.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Legacy twin-bite or burnout interactions do not describe this Emberstrike/Inferno Aegis kit.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Nashor's Tooth, Dusk and Dawn, Terminus, Riftmaker, Rabadon's Deathcap, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.
